people.name: Abraham

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Hagar
people.line: Sarah's Egyptian maidservant; mother of Ishmael.

people.name: Sarah
people.line: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac

translations.web: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
translations.bsb: Now Abram’s wife Sarai had borne him no children, but she had an Egyptian maidservant named Hagar.
translations.kjv: Now Sarai Abram's wife bare him no children: and she had an handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
translations.asv: Now Sarai, Abram's wife, bare him no children: and she had a handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
